resources.string: Based on Dictate Keyboard by DevEmperor,\na fork of FlorisBoard
Zizai
Zizai Keyboard
Find and send GIFs without ever leaving Zizai. Open the GIF panel, search for anything, and drop it straight into your chat — a fast, Gboard-style picker built right in.
Zizai has grown a lot since 5.0. Here are the highlights of 5.1 — tap “Try it” on any page to jump straight to that feature.

Speak for as long as you like. Long recordings are automatically split into segments and transcribed in the background while you keep going, so you get your text sooner and never run into a length limit. Cut a segment yourself, or let Zizai detect natural pauses.
Thanks for using Zizai! If it helps you every day, a small donation keeps the project going. You can revisit any of these tours anytime under Settings › About.
This release takes Zizai beyond its own keyboard: use it as your phone\'s voice input, run a spoken command from anywhere, and let it clean up long dictations for you. Here\'s what\'s new.
Zizai 5.2

Long dictations no longer arrive as one wall of text. Set a word count and Zizai starts a new paragraph at the next sentence end — deterministic, and only for plain transcripts, so AI-formatted text is never second-guessed.

Zizai now registers as a system voice input, so the mic key in other keyboards and apps can transcribe through Zizai — with your provider, your prompts and your on-device models. Enable “Zizai voice input” in your keyboard list and pick it as your voice input method. (Gboard keeps its mic tied to Google, so use a keyboard that honours the system setting.)
Use Zizai from any keyboard
Zizai 5.3

A server of your own can drive live transcription too, if it speaks the OpenAI realtime protocol. And if it sits in front of a machine that sleeps, Zizai can wake it early so the first request is not stuck waiting for it to boot.

Like a voice message: hold the mic key and talk, let go and it is sent. Slide left to throw the recording away, or drag up to lock it hands-free. A quick tap still works the way it always did. Turn it on in the Zizai settings.
New: Zizai Cloud
Zizai 6.0
Whichever way you use Zizai — your own key, your own server, a model on the device, or credit — nothing about the other ways has changed. You can revisit any tour under Settings › About.
Point the keyboard at a folder of your own stickers, share a voice message straight to Zizai to find out what it says, and get an autocorrect that finally sees the mistake it was built not to see.
Zizai 6.1

Zizai now appears in the share sheet for audio and video. Share a voice message to it and a screen opens that starts transcribing by itself — no field to find, no button to press. The transcript is searchable, and long recordings are handled in pieces instead of being turned away.
New: share to Zizai

Point Zizai at any folder and its pictures become stickers — subfolders turn into tabs, with favourites and recents of their own. Add one from any app through the share sheet, delete one without leaving the keyboard. What a chat app will actually accept is not what it says it accepts, so each sticker is brought into shape once on the way in and simply sent from there.

Pick a folder once and every finished dictation is also written into it as a plain text file, the moment it is done. Whatever watches that folder — a notes app, a sync tool, your backup — gets your transcripts without Zizai having to learn its language.
Zizai 6.2

Zizai Glass lets the app show through the gaps between the keys, while the keys themselves stay solid enough to read on; Glass Clear goes further and looks better, at the price of text showing through in apps that draw behind the keyboard. Sand is a warm light theme, Deep a quiet dark one, and E-Ink finally has a night version — so automatic switching no longer hands you a white keyboard after dark.
Zizai 6.3

An IBAN off a letter, a serial number off a box, an address off a parcel: point the camera at it and the text arrives where you were typing, instead of being read out and typed again. It is recognised on this device — nothing is uploaded and no provider is involved. Zizai never asks for the camera permission either: the system camera takes the photo and hands back that one picture, which is deleted as soon as it has been read.
Zizai 6.4

Every part of Zizai was reviewed for privacy and security, and what turned up is fixed. A dictation into a password or PIN field stays out of the history, now also through the floating button. Android’s cloud backup only takes your API keys end-to-end encrypted. And “Trust user certificates” is now set per provider account rather than for all of them at once.
Slide your finger from key to key and Zizai turns the path into whole words. Each language brings its own dictionary that downloads on demand — switch it on under Gestures.
Here’s what’s new in Zizai 5.0 — the highlights in under a minute. Tap “Try it” on any page to jump straight to that setting.
Prefer voice over keys? The keyboard-free screen from Zizai 3 is back — make it your default, or keep it just one swipe away from the full keyboard.
As you type, Zizai suggests fitting words and quietly fixes typos. The word you actually typed stays in the suggestion bar, so a single tap undoes any correction.

This archive carries no API keys, passwords or Zizai Cloud credit, so it can be passed on — but it will not restore yours either. Whatever else is ticked below is still in it, including your transcription history and your clipboard.

This archive contains your API keys and passwords in plain text, along with your Zizai Cloud credit — anyone you give it to can dictate at your expense. Do not pass it on, and if you already have, change the key at your provider. Whatever else is ticked below travels with it, including your transcription history and your clipboard.

This backup archive contains no API keys or passwords. Everything else is restored. Merging keeps the keys already on this device; erasing removes them — including a Zizai Cloud recovery code, which cannot be typed back in.

string.comment: What's-new text for the 4.0.0 release. One change per line.

resources.string:
• Brand-new keyboard: Zizai now ships as a full multi-language layout keyboard with a dedicated mic key that opens the voice panel.
• Bring your own AI: pick any OpenAI-compatible provider and enter your API key under Settings → Zizai.
• Smart formatting and rewording powered by your chosen model.
• Your settings from the previous Zizai app are imported automatically.

string.name: changelog__v4_1_1
string.comment: What's-new text for the 4.1.1 release. One change per line.

resources.string: • Fix: the accent color could appear green on some devices — keys and buttons are back to the Zizai blue.

string.name: changelog__v4_2_0
string.comment: What's-new text for the 4.2.0 release. One change per line.

resources.string:
• NEW: Floating dictation button — dictate straight into any app, even when another keyboard is active. Pick from three styles (Pill, Ring, Orb), watch a live waveform while you speak, drag it anywhere with edge-snapping, set its color and size, and long-press to reword. Turn it on in Settings ▸ Zizai ▸ Floating button.
• NEW: Google Gemini — bring your own AI Studio API key for both transcription and rewording.
• Prompts now appear in an always-on row above the keys by default.
• More reliable text insertion across apps, including browsers and other keyboards.

string.name: changelog__v4_3_0
string.comment: What\'s-new text for the 4.3.0 release. One change per line.

resources.string:
• NEW: On-device transcription — dictate completely offline. No internet needed and nothing leaves your phone. Download a speech model once in Settings ▸ Zizai ▸ Providers. 📴
• NEW: Wear OS keyboard — dictate straight from your watch, through your phone or fully on its own. ⌚
• NEW: Find & replace rules — automatically fix recurring words, names or phrases in every transcript. Set them up in Settings ▸ Zizai ▸ Custom mappings. 🔁
• NEW: Single-call mode — let one capable AI model transcribe and format in a single request, faster and often cheaper. Turn it on per provider. ⚡
• NEW: Smartbar actions to jump back to your previous keyboard or open the system keyboard picker. ⌨️
• The keyboard's accent color now follows the color you pick in Settings ▸ Theme. 🎨
• Added an optional undo button to the floating dictation button. ↩️
• Various fixes and stability improvements. 🛠️

string.name: changelog__v5_0_0
string.comment: What\'s-new text for the 5.0.0 release. One change per line.

resources.string:
• NEW: Glide typing — swipe across the keys to type whole words, with per-language dictionaries that download on demand. 👆
• NEW: Word suggestions & autocorrect — typos get fixed automatically and the word you typed stays one tap away. ✨
• NEW: Real-time transcription — watch your words appear as you speak, with OpenAI, Deepgram, Soniox, AssemblyAI and ElevenLabs. ⚡
• NEW: Three more transcription providers — ElevenLabs Scribe, Deepgram and AssemblyAI. ☁️
• NEW: Classic dictation layout — the keyboard-free voice screen from Zizai 3 is back, locked or just a swipe away. 🎙️
• NEW: Community prompt library — browse and share rewording prompts. 📚
• NEW: Dictation statistics with milestones. 📊
• NEW: Offline model NVIDIA Parakeet, plus a silence filter that skips empty recordings. 📴
• More: a steadier floating button, reasoning-effort control, haptic feedback, a new E-Reader theme and dozens of fixes. 🛠️

string.name: dictate__command_word_info_description
string.comment: Info box explaining what the command word does

resources.string:
Normally Zizai writes down what you say. With a command word set, a dictation that begins with it becomes an instruction instead: the word is removed and the rest is sent to the AI, together with the selected text if there is any.

“Jarvis, make this more formal” rewrites the selection. “Jarvis, what is the capital of Japan” writes the answer into the field. It is the Live prompt button, reached by saying its name instead of tapping it.

The word only counts at the very start of a dictation and only as a whole word, so pick something you rarely begin a sentence with.

resources.string: The folder will hold the text of every dictation you make from now on, and the recordings too if you switch that on. string.name: setup__grant_mic_permission__description
string.comment: Onboarding: ask for microphone permission for dictation

resources.string: Zizai needs microphone access to record your voice for transcription.

As of Android 13+, apps must ask for permission to send notifications. In Zizai Keyboard, this is only used to open a crash report screen in the event of a crash. This permission can be changed at any time in the system settings.
Zizai Cloud: no account anywhere, no API key. You buy dictation minutes through Google Play and they never expire. The convenient way — and somewhat more expensive than going to a provider directly.
Point Zizai at a speech server you run yourself, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Zizai turns your speech into text with an AI service. Two ways suit most people — and if you\'d rather not use a cloud service at all, there are two more below.
Zizai turns your speech into text with the help of an online AI service. To use it, you need your own personal key for such a service.
Choose how Zizai transcribes
An API key is like a personal password that lets Zizai use the service for you. Creating one is free and takes about two minutes.
